messages:
Priya: dropped a short prototype for 'legend density' — goal is a compact legend that still gives findability and outlier cues. figma: https://figma.redwood/legend-density-new
Gus: nice. core problems: long names, many series, and outlier spikes that users need to spot at-a-glance. idea: show compressed rows with swatch + tokenized name + optional outlier sentinel.
Elena: tokenized name sounds good. suggest keeping domain tokens (service/region) and truncating adjectives. show full name in a keyboard-focusable flyout, not only tooltip.
Samir: outlier sentinel: tiny triangle badge on the swatch when recent points exceed threshold. on focus it reads "recent spike: 12,400" and offers 'Show raw' action. make badge at least 12px target.
Priya: copy tweak: label the toggle 'Display: Compact / Exact' instead of symbols. also add quick hint under legend: 'Press p to pin a series'.
A11yBot: checklist: badge must be focusable, use aria-describedby for spike details, and announce spike presence in an aria-live region when a new spike appears. ensure contrast for badge >= 4.5:1.
Gus: responsive: on very narrow widths collapse legend into a row of swatches + a count badge "+12". tapping the count opens a full-screen legend with search and pin. keyboard should open same panel.
Elena: pattern support for colorblind mode: show diagonal hatch on swatches and include pattern legend in flyout. flyout rows should show swatch + pattern + truncated name + tags. keep the flyout searchable.
Samir: smoothing and axis interplay: if a series is smoothed, show a tiny pill 'Smoothed' in the legend row and allow 'Show raw' from the flyout. smoothing presets should be 'Raw / Low / High' with mini-preview sparklines.
Priya: perf note: backend should provide downsampled_preview + outlier_flags so client can render quickly. payload minimal: preview + spikes list for legend badges.
Gus: interaction: pressing enter on a focused legend row opens the flyout; pressing s toggles smoothing for that series; pressing v toggles units for that series view. document shortcuts in help.
Elena: microcopy: in flyout header use 'Series details' and include 'Source' and 'Tags' rows. CTA 'Show raw in chart' not 'Expand' to be explicit.
Samir: action items: Gus will prototype collapsed-row + count badge by Wed; Elena will add flyout with searchable rows and patterns; Priya will finalize copy and keyboard shortcut doc; A11yBot will run checks once prototypes up. timeline: internal review next Thu. :calendar:
